description: Convert an EPUB e-book to PDF in your browser, with its chapters, bookmarks and links intact. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The EPUB e-book (EPUB 2 or 3), base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped if present. Copy-protected (DRM) books are refused with error 'drm', Kindle files with 'mobi'. Up to 50 MB once decoded. A very long book can exceed the memory an API call has; the in-browser tool on the website converts those.

pageSize.description: Paper size of the PDF. a5 is paperback-sized and reads like a book on screen; a4 or letter print on ordinary paper. Defaults to a5.

name: epub_to_pdf
title: EPUB to PDF
